data.name: Arrio Saputra
data.title: Application Developer • Full Stack Engineer
data.headline: Engineering robust enterprise systems, secure REST APIs, and scalable digital products.
data.about:
My name is Arrio Saputra, and I graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Informatics from Universitas Teknologi Digital Indonesia with a 3.85 GPA. I am passionate about software development, particularly web application development, system integration, database optimization, and application security.

I have professional experience as a Full Stack Developer, developing and maintaining web-based applications from requirement analysis to deployment. During my career, I have worked on e-commerce platforms, procurement systems, mentoring platforms, and enterprise applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.
